'''Kobbu''' was a green-gray [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] with warts and a pathological liar.

==Biography==
Due to a bet he made with a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], Kobbu was captured and imprisoned by slaver [[Phylus Mon]] in his zoo at the ship ''[[Animiasma]]''. There, in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[A Mon Alone]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Kobbu would hover in his cell. Whenever he found anyone he could think could help him, he pretended to be a mighty [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] eager to punish the evil-doers who did that.

Phylus Mon surgically inserted an explosive near the heart of each of his slaves. The explosive would be activated in the case of Phylus Mon's death, but it could also be deactivated with the impact of an [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion weapon]]. All the slaves in Phylus Mon's zoo were also regularly battered.
